$comment: Codelist-attribute profile. Fixed attribute sets the Schematron (common/sch/01-ESPD-common-cl-attributes.sch) requires on code elements, defined ONCE per codelist. The compiler stamps these onto any element whose encoding-profile entry names the matching codelist. Values are copied verbatim from the Schematron (several carry dated listVersionIDs). 'criterion-id' is not a Schematron codelist rule but the UBL identifier scheme attributes seen on every cbc:ID in ESPD-Request-BASE.xml; it is included here so the compiler has one place for all fixed attribute sets.

criterion-id.$note: UBL identifier scheme on every criterion/group/property cbc:ID (not a Schematron codelist rule; from ESPD-Request-BASE.xml).

criterion.listAgencyName: Publications Office of the European Union

country.$note: cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode. Used both inside a criterion (C07's CODE_COUNTRY) and in the document header (Part I buyer / Part II EO postal address). listAgencyID is NOT required by 01-ESPD-common-cl-attributes.sch (its country rule leaves it commented out) but IS required (fatal) by 04-ESPD-common-other-br.sch BR-OTH-01-20 on cbc:IdentificationCode — which only bites once a full document emits the element (the single-criterion splice reuses the BASE's own hand-written address). Value 'OP' matches ESPD-Request/Response-BASE.xml. Dated listVersionID differs from the 5.0.0 lists.

boolean-gui-control-type.$note: cbc:ExpectedCode for CODE_BOOLEAN (C29 'Threshold per year'). 01-cl-attributes.sch has no dedicated context for this list, so only the generic listID/listAgencyID/listVersionID (04-common-other-br.sch) apply; values copied from ESPD-Request-BASE.xml.

financial-ratio-type.$note: cbc:ExpectedCode for CODE (C34 'Ratio Type'). Generic listID/listAgencyID/listVersionID from ESPD-Request-BASE.xml.

occupation.$note: cbc:ExpectedCode for CODE (C25 'occupation'). A DIFFERENT codelist/agency/version from financial-ratio-type — the per-leaf CODE codelist case. A dated EU authority list; values from the XSLT (listAgencyID=EMPL).

eo-role-type.$note: cac:EconomicOperatorParty/cac:EconomicOperatorRole/cbc:RoleCode (Part II EO role). Attributes from 01-ESPD-common-cl-attributes.sch (dated listVersionID 20211208-0).
eo-role-type.listAgencyName: Publications Office of the European Union

economic-operator-size.$note: cac:EconomicOperatorParty/cac:Party/cbc:IndustryClassificationCode (Part II EO size). Dated listVersionID 20240612-0, from ESPD-Response-BASE.xml.

procurement-procedure-type.$note: cbc:ProcedureCode (Part I Section C, procedure type). BR-SC-10 makes the ELEMENT mandatory (fatal) and BR-OTH-01-10/20/30 make listID/listAgencyID/listVersionID mandatory (fatal). CAVEAT: no .gc for this list is shipped in ESPD-EDM/codelists, and the CVA has no context for cbc:ProcedureCode — so code VALUES are neither enum-derivable nor validated. Attribute values taken from espd-tools/modules/espd_constants.cjs (versions 4.0.0/4.1.0); the 5.0.0 BASE sample still carries 3.3.0-era dummies ('Dummy_procurement-procedure-type', 'yyyymmdd-0').

docrefcontent-type.$note: cac:AdditionalDocumentReference/cbc:DocumentTypeCode (Part I publication reference type). 01-ESPD-common-cl-attributes.sch (line 74) mandates listName/listID/listVersionID/listSchemeURI/listURI and does NOT require listAgencyID; but 04-ESPD-common-other-br.sch BR-OTH-01-20 (fatal) requires listAgencyID on cbc:DocumentTypeCode once a full document emits it. Value 'OP' per the Publications Office authority list (consistent with the other EU-authority lists here). Other values from the Schematron + DocrefcontentType.gc Identification block.
